rationale:
Issue #116 reports that Yams resolved quoted scalars (`version: "10.10"`) to Float instead of String, which is a spec-conformance defect: YAML requires non-plain (quoted/literal/folded) scalars to resolve to tag:yaml.org,2002:str. Although the reporter phrased it as a configuration request, the maintainer treated it as a bug (commit message 'Parse quoted values as strings / Fix #116', CHANGELOG entry placed under 'Bug Fixes' in patches/original-commit.patch) and fixed the default resolution rather than adding any option or new API. The minimized production patch is a single hunk in Sources/Yams/Parser.swift replacing the guard that returned nil for implicit scalars with `if event.data.scalar.quoted_implicit == 1 { return Tag.Name.str.rawValue }`, which is exactly the tag-resolution path responsible for the reported mis-typing; the patch is byte-identical to the production fix (sha256 8781ef9d...), touches no other file, and contains no refactor, formatting, docs, or config change (CHANGELOG is excluded from the production/minimized patch). Triggers come from the same upstream commit and use only pre-existing public APIs: testQuotationMark calls Yams.load and compares against PyYAML reference output for plain/single/double/literal/folded scalars, directly reproducing the issue reproducer; testNextRootThrowsOnInvalidYaml changes the expected tag of an empty literal scalar from Tag(.null) to Tag(.str), an existing API and the same root cause (non-plain scalars must resolve to str). Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization matrices reports all gates passing, including buggy differential reproduction of both selectors, deterministic outcomes over 3 repetitions, and a green fixed full suite. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and jpsim/yams#116 is the sole allowed verified issue key, so no duplicate root cause exists.

Issue #116 reports that Yams resolves quoted scalars (`version: "10.10"`) to Float instead of String, which is a YAML spec conformance defect rather than a new capability: quoted and block scalars are never subject to implicit type resolution. The fix commit (message 'Parse quoted values as strings\n\nFix #116', PR #117, verified traceability path fix_commit_to_issue) changes exactly one production location, `Event.scalarTag` in Sources/Yams/Parser.swift, to return `Tag.Name.str` when `quoted_implicit == 1` instead of returning nil. For plain implicit scalars the new `string(from: event.data.scalar.tag)` path still yields nil because libyaml supplies no tag, so no behavior outside the defect is altered and no new public API is introduced. The minimized patch is byte-identical to the production fix (sha256 8781ef9d..., single hunk, retained_hunks=[1]); the CHANGELOG entry and test files are excluded, so no documentation-, config-, or test-only content remains. Trigger testQuotationMark is the upstream test from the same commit and encodes the issue's exact reproducer (plain 10.10 stays Double while single-quoted, double-quoted, literal, and folded 10.10 become Strings), cross-checked against PyYAML reference output. The second trigger, testNextRootThrowsOnInvalidYaml, is an existing test whose assertion changes from `Node("", Tag(.null), .literal)` to `Node("", Tag(.str), .literal)`; that is the same root cause (a non-plain scalar being left untagged and resolved as null) and uses only pre-existing `Node`/`Tag` APIs. Strict machine evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs reports passed=true with no failed checks: both revisions build, both selectors fail on the buggy revision and pass on the fixed revision across 3 repetitions and 38 matrix runs, buggy full-suite failures are limited to the reproduced triggers, and the fixed full suite is green. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and jpsim/yams#116 is in allowed_root_cause_ids, so this root cause is not a registry duplicate.
